components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single obvious next action on a library, editor, or prompt surface.
components.css: .ds-primary { background:#C9CEFF; color:#111217; border:0; border-radius:12px; padding:10px 16px; font:600 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; transition:background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#D8DCFF; } .ds-primary:active { background:#AAB4FF; transform:scale(.98); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #AAB4FF; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Script Row
components.description: A readable library row with title, preview, and useful metadata.
components.css: .ds-script-row { width:260px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; align-items:flex-start; background:#272830; color:#F6F6F8; border:0; border-radius:12px; padding:12px; text-align:left; } .ds-script-row:hover { background:#30313A; } .ds-script-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C9CEFF; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-script-title { font:600 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-script-meta { color:#B9BAC4; font:500 12px ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Prompt Dock
components.description: A temporary floating control group over the reading surface.
components.css: .ds-prompt-dock { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; background:rgba(27,28,34,.88); color:#F6F6F8; border-radius:16px; padding:8px; backdrop-filter:blur(18px); } .ds-prompt-dock button { width:44px; height:44px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:#272830; color:#F6F6F8; font:600 18px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-prompt-dock button:hover { background:#343640; } .ds-prompt-dock button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C9CEFF; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-prompt-dock .ds-play { background:#C9CEFF; color:#111217; }

narrative.overview: Kyuva behaves like the dark space immediately around a camera lens: visually quiet, precisely aligned, and present only to help the speaker stay connected. Graphite surfaces reduce glare during delivery, while the pearl-lavender accent recalls the app icon's optical glass and marks only the current selection, reading cue, and primary action.
keyCharacteristics: Script-dominant layouts with a clear library-to-editor-to-prompt sequence.
Restrained graphite neutrals with one optical lavender accent.
Familiar Apple navigation and controls, tuned for confident large-type reading.
Fast 150–200 ms state transitions that respect reduced motion.
Tonal grouping instead of nested cards and decorative shadows.

rules.name: The One Lens Rule
rules.body: Lens lavender occupies no more than ten percent of an editor screen; its rarity identifies what the user can do next.

rules.name: The Words Own the Scale Rule
rules.body: The largest text in a prompt is always the script. App labels never compete with it.

rules.name: The Glass Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Glass is permitted only for controls that physically overlay moving script text. It is forbidden as decoration in libraries, editors, settings, or empty states.

dos: Do make the user's script the largest and quietest uninterrupted surface.
Do preserve familiar Apple list, navigation, menu, slider, and accessibility behavior.
donts: Don't recreate a Settings-window utility where writing a script feels like configuring software.
Don't build a control-dense production dashboard or generic SaaS card grid.
Don't use neon cyan gaming controls, decorative gradients, or glass on every surface.
